label: Generic chat model (no tool execution)
grounding: fallback — assumes the model can only reply with text

plan_mode.how: present plan and wait for approval

shell.how: print the exact command for the user to run, then wait for its output

edit_file.how: print a unified diff for the user to apply

write_file.how: print the full file in a fenced block with its path

read_file.how: ask the user to paste the file

grep.how: give the user an rg command and ask for output
